info.name: Washermann API
info.description:
Washermann Platform API — Phase 1: Auth & Users | Phase 2: Companies & Tiers | Phase 3: Financial Foundation (Wallets, WashPoints, Top-up) | Phase 6: Washermen & Orders (Areas, Vendors, Reps, Pricing, Orders, Assignment, Payouts)

## Setup
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your API URL (default: http://localhost:3000/api/v1)
2. Use **POST /auth/login** or **POST /auth/register** — the collection auto-sets `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and `topupKey` variables.
3. All authenticated requests automatically use the `accessToken` variable.
4. Set variables like `areaId`, `vendorId`, `repId`, `orderId` as you work through the Phase 6 endpoints.

## Financial Flow
1. Call `GET /conversion-rates/active` to see the current NGN → WashPoint rate.
2. Call `POST /wallets/me/topup` with the `X-WM-Topup-Code` header (generated by mobile app using `topupKey`) to initiate payment.
3. Pay via the Paystack authorization URL returned.
4. Paystack posts to `POST /webhooks/paystack` — wallet is credited automatically.
5. Use `GET /wallets/me/topup/:reference` as a mobile fallback to verify payment status.

## Order Flow (Phase 6)
1. **GET /areas** — find your area.
2. **GET /pricing/config/:areaId** — fetch price config for local preview.
3. **POST /pricing/calculate** — get authoritative total before placing order.
4. **POST /orders** — place order (debits wallet into escrow).
5. Admin triggers rep assignment via **POST /assignment/orders/:orderId/start-rep**.
6. Rep accepts via **POST /assignment/orders/:orderId/accept/rep**.
7. Vendor accepts via **POST /assignment/orders/:orderId/accept/vendor**.
8. Rep logs garment count at pickup → **POST /orders/:orderId/garment-log**.
9. Rep marks PICKED_UP → IN_PROGRESS → QUALITY_CHECK → READY_FOR_DELIVERY → REP_COLLECTED → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED.
10. Customer confirms → **POST /orders/:orderId/confirm-delivery** (releases escrow to vendor).
11. Customer rates → **POST /orders/:orderId/rate**.

Identifier-first flow. Returns: not_found | active | pending_activation | suspended. Mobile uses this to route to the correct screen.

Get current authenticated user info and roles.

item.name: Users
item.description: User profile, address management and company membership view

request.description: Get the authenticated user's profile.
Update own profile. All fields are optional.
List all active company memberships for the authenticated employee. Returns assignment records with company and tier details.
List all saved addresses for the authenticated user. Default address appears first.
Add a new address. If isDefault is true, existing default is unset. First address is automatically set as default.
Update an existing address. All fields optional.
Delete an address. If the deleted address was the default, the most recent remaining address is promoted.
Set an address as the default delivery address.
[Admin only] List all users with pagination.

item.name: Companies
item.description: Company management, tiers, employee assignments and admin grants. Company-scoped endpoints require either Role.ADMIN (platform admin) or Role.COMPANY_ADMIN for that specific company.

request.description: [Admin only] Create a new company on the platform. Auto-saves the returned ID as `companyId` collection variable.
[Admin only] Paginated list of all companies on the platform.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Get company details including its tiers.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Update company name or contact details. All fields optional.
[Admin only] Toggle company status. status: 'active' | 'inactive'.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] List all benefit tiers for the company.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Create a new benefit tier for the company. monthlyPoints = Wash Points allocated per cycle. Auto-saves returned ID as `tierId`.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Update tier fields. All fields optional. Changes apply from the next billing cycle.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Delete a tier. All employees on this tier will have their tierId set to null (unassigned) via SET NULL FK.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Paginated list of all employees in this company. Returns assignment records with embedded user and tier.

[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Add an employee by email or phone. If the user already exists → creates assignment and notifies. If new → creates PENDING user, assignment, Redis invite token (7d TTL), and sends invite via email/SMS. tierId is optional.
When the email/phone does not match any existing user, a PENDING account is created and an invite email/SMS is sent with a deep-link containing the invite token.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Soft-remove an employee (sets assignmentStatus to 'inactive'). They can be re-added later.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Move an employee to a different tier. Pass tierId: null to unassign. Takes effect from the next billing cycle.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] List all admins for this company.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Grant company_admin role to an existing user. Creates a CompanyAdmin record and appends Role.COMPANY_ADMIN to their roles array.
[Admin | CompanyAdmin] Remove company admin access. If the user has no remaining admin memberships across any company, the COMPANY_ADMIN role is stripped from their profile.

item.name: Wallets
item.description:
WashPoint wallet balance, transaction ledger, top-up flows and admin manual adjustments.

**Top-up flow:**
1. `POST /wallets/me/topup` → returns Paystack `authorizationUrl` + `reference`
2. User completes payment in browser/WebView
3. Paystack fires webhook → wallet credited automatically
4. `GET /wallets/me/topup/:reference` as fallback verification

**X-WM-Topup-Code header:** A time-based HMAC code generated by the mobile app each time a top-up is initiated. It is derived from `topupKey` (returned at login), `userId`, and the current time window — preventing replay attacks.

request.description: Get authenticated user's WashPoint balance and total fiat spent (sum of all successful Paystack transactions).
Paginated WashPoint transaction history. Each entry shows type (credit/debit), amount, running balance, source (topup, order_payment, etc.), and the conversion rate snapshot used.

header.description: Time-based HMAC code generated by mobile app from topupKey. In dev mode (env vars unset) any value is accepted.

request.description: Initiate a WashPoints top-up via Paystack. Returns `authorizationUrl` (open in browser/WebView), `reference`, `washPointsPreview` and `conversionRate`. The `X-WM-Topup-Code` header is required and must be a valid HMAC code derived from `topupKey`. Auto-saves `paymentReference` variable.
Poll payment status for a specific reference. Used as a fallback when the webhook is delayed. If the payment is successful and not yet credited, credits the wallet now.
[Admin only] View any user's wallet balance and fiat spend. Uses the `userId` collection variable.
[Admin only] Manually add WashPoints to a user's wallet. Creates a ledger entry with source: admin_credit. Requires a description for audit trail.
[Admin only] Manually deduct WashPoints from a user's wallet. Fails if balance is insufficient. Requires a description for audit trail.

item.name: Conversion Rates
item.description:
WashPoint ↔ fiat conversion rate management.

**How rates work:**
- Rates are append-only (no edits, no deletes).
- A new rate becomes **active after a configurable delay** (default 60 min) — this prevents an attacker from spiking the rate just before a top-up.
- The rate is **locked at top-up initiation** and stored in the transaction — the webhook uses the snapshot, not the live rate.
- Changing the rate requires answering a **security question** (bcrypt-verified). Use `GET /conversion-rates/challenge` to fetch the question first.

query.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. NGN). Optional — returns all active rates when omitted.

request.description: **Public.** Get the currently active conversion rate for a currency. Returns the most recent rate where `effective_from <= NOW()`. Rate tells you how many WashPoints 1 Naira buys (`pointsPerUnit`).

query.description: Optional filter. Omit to get history for all currencies.

request.description: **Public.** Full history of all conversion rates (including future-effective ones). Ordered by `effective_from` DESC.
[Admin only] Retrieve the security question that must be answered before a rate change can be submitted. The answer is bcrypt-verified server-side.

[Admin only] Set a new conversion rate. `pointsPerUnit` = WashPoints awarded per 1 Naira (e.g. 10 means ₦1 = 10 WP). Requires the correct `securityAnswer`. The new rate becomes active after the configured delay (default 60 min, see `RATE_CHANGE_EFFECTIVE_DELAY_MINUTES` in .env).

item.name: Webhooks (Dev Testing)
item.description:
Paystack webhook receiver. In production these are called by Paystack, not manually.

**Signature:** Paystack signs the raw JSON body with HMAC-SHA512 using your `PAYSTACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. The signature is in the `x-paystack-signature` header.

**Important:** Always returns HTTP 200 even on errors — returning non-2xx causes Paystack to retry, which can cause duplicate processing.

**For local testing:** Use the Paystack dashboard test webhooks feature, or a tool like Ngrok to expose your local server.

header.description: HMAC-SHA512 of raw body signed with PAYSTACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET. In dev, the server logs a warning and processes it anyway if the secret is not set.

request.description: Simulate a Paystack `charge.success` webhook. Replace `{{paymentReference}}` with a real reference from a PENDING transaction. **Requires a valid HMAC-SHA512 signature in production.** Always returns `{ received: true }`.
Simulate a Paystack `charge.failed` webhook. Marks the transaction as FAILED. Always returns `{ received: true }`.

item.name: Areas
item.description: Geographic service area management. Areas define the zones where vendors and reps operate. Vendors and reps are tagged with area IDs; orders reference an area for pricing and assignment.

request.description: [Admin] Create a new geographic service area. `adjacentAreaIds` is an array of area UUIDs that share rep/vendor pools.
List all areas. Accessible to all authenticated users — needed for pickup address resolution on client.
Get a single area by UUID.
[Admin] Update area metadata or adjacent areas.
[Admin] Soft-deactivates an area (sets isActive = false). Does not delete data.

item.name: Vendors

request.description: [Admin] Create a vendor account. Creates a linked user account with role=vendor, creates vendor record, and bootstraps an earnings wallet.
[Admin/Finance] List all vendors with optional filters for verificationStatus and availability.
[Admin/Finance] Get full vendor profile by ID.
[Admin] Update vendor profile fields.
[Admin] Verify or reject a vendor. status: VERIFIED | REJECTED | SUSPENDED. Sets verifiedBy and verifiedAt.
[Admin] Suspend a vendor, preventing order assignment.
[Vendor] Get own vendor profile.
[Vendor] Update own profile (address, availability, bank details). Cannot change verificationStatus.
[Admin] Get all documents submitted by a vendor.
[Vendor] Propose a new per-garment pricing schedule. Subject to admin approval. Cooldown period applies (default 90 days) between proposals.
[Admin/Finance] Full pricing history for a vendor (all approved + pending proposals).
[Admin/Finance] Get the currently active pricing for a vendor.
[Admin] Approve a pending pricing proposal. Deactivates any previously active pricing for this vendor.
[Admin] Reject a pending pricing proposal with a reason.
[Vendor] Get own earnings wallet balance (in WashPoints).
[Vendor] Get own ledger — all credits and debits on the earnings wallet.
[Admin/Finance] Get earnings wallet for any vendor.
[Admin/Finance] Get full ledger for any vendor.

item.name: Reps
item.description: Field representative management. Reps handle pickup and delivery. They earn WP into a pseudo-wallet (internal salary reference — not a spending wallet). Admin-managed lifecycle.

request.description: [Admin] Create a new field rep. Creates a linked user account with role=rep, creates rep record, and bootstraps a pseudo-wallet.
[Admin/Finance] List all reps with optional filters.
[Admin/Finance] Get full rep profile by ID.
[Admin] Update rep profile, status, or area assignments.
[Admin] Clear the review flag on a rep after admin has reviewed and taken action. Resets flaggedForReview = false.
[Rep] Get own rep profile.
[Rep] Toggle own availability. When isAvailable = false the rep will not receive assignment broadcasts.
[Admin/Finance] Get the rep pseudo-wallet (internal salary reference, not a spending wallet).
[Admin/Finance] Full pseudo-wallet ledger for a rep — all WP credits from order completions and bonuses.

item.name: Platform Config
item.description: Global platform settings (rates, fees, timeouts), price list entries (platform-level garment prices), and rep bonus tiers. All admin-only writes.

request.description: [Admin/Finance] Retrieve the single-row platform configuration.
[Admin] Update any field on the platform config. Only provided fields are changed (PATCH semantics).
[Admin/Finance] Get all active platform price list entries (platform-level per-garment WP prices).
[Admin] Add a new platform price list entry. Append-only — a new entry supersedes previous ones for the same garmentType.
[Admin/Finance] Get all rep bonus tiers (rating thresholds → bonus %).
[Admin] Create or update a bonus tier. flagReview=true causes reps in this tier to be automatically flagged for admin review at the end of each cycle.
[Admin] Soft-deactivate a bonus tier (sets isActive = false). Does not delete.

item.name: Pricing
item.description: Order price calculation. Two modes: (1) GET /pricing/config/:areaId — client fetches once and recalculates locally on every cart change without an API call. (2) POST /pricing/calculate — authoritative server-side calculation. The server runs this again at order placement; never trust the client-provided total.

request.description: Fetch the full price config object for a given area. Client caches for ~5 min and recalculates locally on every garment change. Includes: serviceChargePercent, transportFeeWP, vendor garment prices (WP), platform price list, rep commission %.

Server-side authoritative price calculation. Returns full itemised breakdown in WP including garment subtotals, transport fee, service charge, and grand total. Used to display the exact amount before the customer confirms payment. The order placement endpoint runs this again internally.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Full order lifecycle from placement to delivery and rating. Customers place orders (WP debited to escrow), reps and vendors are assigned, order progresses through status transitions, escrow releases to vendor on completion.

request.description: Place a new order. Debits the customer's wallet into escrow atomically. The server recalculates the price — the client-provided total is never trusted. Returns the full order object including the authoritative pricingSnapshot.
List own orders (customer). Filterable by status.
Get full order details by ID including pricingSnapshot, garmentLog, and assignment info.
Get the full append-only status history for an order.
Customer confirms delivery. Triggers escrow release: vendor wallet credited (vendor share in WP), rep pseudo-wallet credited (commission in WP), escrow record closed.
Cancel an order (customer). Only allowed in early statuses (PENDING_PAYMENT, PENDING_ASSIGNMENT). Refunds WP from escrow back to customer wallet.
Rate a completed order. Creates a RatingEvent for both rep and vendor. Updates their rolling 30-day average ratings. Can only rate once per order.
[Rep] Log actual garment count at pickup. This triggers vendor share calculation (locks the Naira value into WP at current rate). Must be called before marking PICKED_UP.
[Rep] Mark order as PICKED_UP — rep has collected from customer and is heading to vendor.
[Rep] Confirm pickup from vendor after washing is done (READY_FOR_DELIVERY → REP_COLLECTED).
[Rep] Mark order as OUT_FOR_DELIVERY — rep is en route to customer.
[Rep] Mark order as DELIVERED — rep has handed over to customer. Awaiting customer confirmation.
[Vendor] Mark order as IN_PROGRESS — washing has started.
[Vendor] Mark order as QUALITY_CHECK — washing done, inspection in progress.
[Vendor] Mark order as READY_FOR_DELIVERY — packed and ready for rep to collect.
[Admin/Finance/Dispute Resolver] List all orders with rich filters.
[Admin] Force-complete an order — releases escrow, credits vendor and rep wallets. Used when customer confirmation is delayed or disputed.

item.name: Assignment
item.description: Rep and vendor broadcast and manual assignment. Orders start in PENDING_ASSIGNMENT. Admin triggers a broadcast to N nearest available reps (configurable). First rep to accept wins. Then vendor broadcast follows the same pattern.

request.description: [Admin] Broadcast order to the top N available reps in the area (default N=3, configurable via ASSIGNMENT_BROADCAST_N env). Sets order status to REP_ASSIGNMENT_PENDING.
[Rep] Accept an order that has been broadcast to them. First rep to accept wins — others are ignored. Sets repId on the order and moves status to VENDOR_ASSIGNMENT_PENDING.
[Vendor] Accept an order that has been assigned to them. Sets vendorId on the order and moves status to CONFIRMED.
[Admin] Bypass broadcast and directly assign a specific rep to an order.
[Admin] Bypass broadcast and directly assign a specific vendor to an order.
[Admin] Get full broadcast history for an order — all rep/vendor broadcasts, their status (pending/accepted/expired/declined), and timestamps.

item.name: Payouts
item.description: Vendor payout requests and rep bonus cycle. Vendors accumulate WP earnings and request cash-out. Admin/Finance approves and triggers bank transfer via Paystack. Rep bonuses are calculated monthly based on 30-day average rating.

request.description: [Vendor] Request a payout from the vendor earnings wallet. amountWP is debited from the wallet at approval. nairaAmount is calculated at the platform's current payoutRateNairaPerWP and locked into the request.
[Vendor] Get own payout request history with pagination.
[Admin/Finance] List all payout requests across all vendors. Filterable by vendorId and status (PENDING | PROCESSING | COMPLETED | FAILED | CANCELLED).

[Admin/Finance] Approve a pending payout. Debits the vendor wallet, records approvedBy and approvedAt, sets status to PROCESSING then COMPLETED. In production this triggers a Paystack Transfer API call.

[Admin] Manually trigger the rep bonus cycle. Calculates 30-day average rating for all active reps, maps to bonus tier (% of cycle WP balance), credits bonus to pseudo-wallet, flags low-rated reps for review, then resets cycle balance. Returns a full report.
